time_format.description: Time format in log (e.g., %H:%M:%S for HH:MM:SS).

date_format.description: Date format in log (e.g., %Y-%m-%d for ISO dates).

time_zone.description: Time zone to use for parsing and displaying timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York').

daemon_mode.description: Run as background daemon (required for real-time streaming).

output_html.description: Enable HTML report generation (required for web UI / real-time dashboard).

ssl_cert.description: SSL certificate file path (required if ws_ssl=true).

ssl_key.description: SSL private key file path (required if ws_ssl=true).

log_file.description: Primary log file path (supports wildcards for multiple files).

ignore_search_engine.description: If true, exclude known search engine bots and queries from reports.

geoip_database.description: Path to MaxMind GeoIP database file (e.g., /usr/share/GeoIP/GeoLite2-Country.mmdb). Leave empty to disable.

output_json.description: Enable JSON output for programmatic access.
